sourceEvidence.text: Awful was formed from an older form of awe with -ful. Medieval uses concerned fear, reverence, or inspiring awe; the familiar modern judgement that something is very bad is a later weakening. The historical formation therefore should not be presented as a literal explanation that modern awful means admirable.
